entries.name: Janet McCloud

expected_cases.charges: Obstructing a public officer during the October 13, 1965 Nisqually fish-in
expected_cases.convicted: No — acquitted by jury in January 1969
expected_cases.sentence: Arrested October 13, 1965; acquitted by a jury in January 1969. Laura McCloud recalled that the defendants posted bail within hours of arrest, while the 2003 Seattle Post-Intelligencer obituary reports six days in jail and a hunger strike. These conflicting custody accounts remain unresolved; no exact release day or verified six-day total is assigned. October 1965 release is retained at month precision. Janet McCloud also described a separate 1966 arrest and hunger strike with Edith McCloud and Dick Gregory; that episode must not be conflated with this prosecution.
